Reporting
parking violations
Contact Sacramento City 311 to request Parking
Enforcement service for parking violations that
may include, but are not limited to, vehicles
parked:
• blocking a driveway
• on the sidewalk
• within 15- 20 feet of a marked or unmarked
crosswalk
• obstructing a crosswalk
• in a bus zone or bike lane
• without authorization on private property
• illegally with a residential permit
Unattached trailers & boats
Sacramento City Code section 10.36.080
prohibits the parking of any unattached
trailer, semitrailer, or equipment as defined
by California Vehicle Code section 225, for
more than 4 hours on the street in a 24-hour
period.
Violations of this city code may be reported
to Parking Enforcement by contacting
Sacramento City 311.
Confidentiality
The name of the person reporting a parking
violation will not be disclosed to any party
aside from City enforcement personnel who
need access to that information. Reports may
be submitted anonymously to Sacramento
City 311.
